features.body: Until the end of the round, whenever a high elf uses a magic ability, they can use it as if they were occupying the square of another high elf on the encounter map to whom they have line of effect.
features.name: Chaincast

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: The high elf chooses a damage type and condition from one of the following combinations: cold damage and [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed), poison damage and [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened), or corruption damage and [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened).

sections.label: Special
sections.text: This ability can't be used by a [minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion).

features.body: Until the end of the round, each high elf in the encounter gains a +4 bonus to speed, and whenever a high elf uses an ability against an enemy, each high elf [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to that enemy can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against them.
features.name: In Defiance of Time

flavor: At the start of any high elf's turn, you can spend Malice to activate one of the following features.
name: High Elf Malice
